rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when people or things physically separate or go apart.

example.english: They diverge at the street corner and each go home.
example.traditional: 佢哋行到街口就分開，各自返屋企。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 haang4 dou3 gaai1 hau2 zau6 fan1 hoi1 gok3 zi6 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this specifically when roads, paths, routes, or similar lines branch off in different directions.

example.english: We watch the road diverge ahead and take the one on the left.
example.traditional: 前面條路分岔，我哋行左邊嗰條。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 tiu4 lou6 fan1 caa3 ngo5 dei6 haang4 zo2 bin1 go2 tiu4

rows.note: Use this when stories, ideas, results, or other things gradually become different rather than physically separating.

example.english: The two versions of the story gradually diverge towards the end.
example.traditional: 兩個版本嘅故事去到結尾，慢慢變得唔同。
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 baan2 bun2 ge3 gu3 si6 heoi3 dou3 git3 mei5 maan6 maan6 bin3 dak1 m4 tung4
